ucs.title: [LLM] Turla ComRAT v4 C2 over Gmail web interface (non-browser process)
ucs.description: Hunts a non-browser binary establishing connections to Google's webmail endpoints — the signature C2 channel of Turla's ComRAT v4 (Agent.BTZ lineage), which reads tasking from and exfiltrates to a hardcoded Gmail inbox via the web UI using stolen cookies rather than the IMAP/SMTP protocol. Tied to Turla / Snake / Secret Blizzard (FSB Center 16) tradecraft of abusing trusted cloud services for bidirectional C2.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t allow_old_summaries=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Network_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest_host IN ("mail.google.com","www.gmail.com","gmail.com")) AND NOT (All_Traffic.process_name IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe","googleupdate.exe","googledrivesync.exe","thunderbird.exe","outlook.exe")) by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.user All_Traffic.process_name All_Traffic.dest_host All_Traffic.dest_port
| `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`
| where isnotnull(process_name) AND process_name!="unknown"
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where RemoteUrl has_any ("mail.google.com","www.gmail.com","gmail.com") or (RemoteIPType == "Public" and RemoteUrl has "googleusercontent.com")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe","googleupdate.exe","googledrivesync.exe","thunderbird.exe","outlook.exe","msedgewebview2.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp), Conns=count(), Urls=make_set(RemoteUrl, 10) by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessSHA256
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Turla ComRAT Non-Browser Process Resolving Gmail Web Interface
status: experimental
description: Detects a non-browser process resolving Google webmail domains, consistent with Turla ComRAT v4 C2 over the Gmail web UI.
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName|endswith:
      - 'mail.google.com'
      - 'gmail.com'
  filter_browsers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\brave.exe'
      - '\opera.exe'
      - '\iexplore.exe'
      - '\googleupdate.exe'
      - '\thunderbird.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter_browsers
falsepositives:
  - Custom Gmail API integrations or scripts using a service account
level: high
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1102.002
  - attack.t1071.001
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @DestinationHostname:(*mail.google.com* OR *gmail.com*) -@Image:(*\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\MSEdge.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\iexplore.exe OR *\googleupdate.exe OR *\GoogleUpdate.exe OR *\outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\thunderbird.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(mail\.google\.com|gmail\.com)$/i
| NOT (ContextImageFileName=/\\(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|opera|iexplore|thunderbird|outlook|googleupdate|googledrivesync)\.exe$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=count())
| count > 0
ucs.rationale: Generic 'process talks to Gmail' is noise; the discriminator here is the non-browser initiating process, which is exactly what makes ComRAT v4 unique among APTs — it impersonates a logged-in Gmail web session from a planted C++ DLL (loaded into services/explorer context) rather than using a mail client or browser. ucs.title: [LLM] Turla PowerStallion / PowerShell C2 over OneDrive WebDAV
ucs.description: Hunts PowerShell, net.exe, or rundll32 referencing OneDrive WebDAV endpoints (d.docs.live.net / onedrive.live.com / DavWWWRoot), the C2 mechanism of Turla's PowerStallion lightweight PowerShell backdoor, which mounts an attacker OneDrive folder via the WebDAV mini-redirector to fetch tasking and stage tools. Distinctive to Turla / Venomous Bear / Waterbug cloud-storage C2.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t allow_old_summaries=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","rundll32.exe")) AND (Processes.process IN ("*d.docs.live.net*","*onedrive.live.com*","*docs.live.net*","*DavWWWRoot*","*@SSL*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where NOT match(user, "\$$")
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","rundll32.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("d.docs.live.net","onedrive.live.com","docs.live.net","DavWWWRoot","@SSL")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("use","New-PSDrive","WebClient","DownloadString","DownloadFile","Invoke-WebRequest","iwr","Copy-Item")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","rundll32.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any ("d.docs.live.net","onedrive.live.com","docs.live.net","DavWWWRoot","@SSL")
| where CommandLine has_any ("use","New-PSDrive","WebClient","DownloadString","DownloadFile","Invoke-WebRequest","iwr","Copy-Item")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, AccountName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc

status: experimental
description: Detects PowerShell/net.exe/rundll32 referencing OneDrive WebDAV endpoints, consistent with Turla PowerStallion cloud-storage C2.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'd.docs.live.net'
      - 'onedrive.live.com'
      - 'docs.live.net'
      - 'DavWWWRoot'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate scripts syncing personal OneDrive via WebDAV (rare in enterprise)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1102
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1071.001
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\net.exe OR *\net1.exe OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDLL32.exe) @CommandLine:(*d.docs.live.net* OR *onedrive.live.com* OR *docs.live.net* OR *DavWWWRoot*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|net1?|rundll32)\.exe$/i
| regex("(d\\.docs\\.live\\.net|onedrive\\.live\\.com|docs\\.live\\.net|DavWWWRoot)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName], function=count())
| count > 0
